messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PDR-789 triggered for service=inference-gateway — 5xx error rate 7.3% over 3m in region=usw2. Link: https://pdr/redwood/PDR-789
alice: acked PDR-789 — I'm on it
pagerbot: PagerDuty: escalated to ben.sre and oncall-sre
alice: quick triage — spike started ~1754321860, looks correlated with auth-proxy changes
ben: confirming 503s in auth-proxy logs, sample: `2026-07-03T14:04:20Z auth-proxy error upstream: 503`
chandra: checking deploybot for recent deploys
deploybot: Deployed auth-proxy v2.4.1 canary at 1754321800 -> prod started 1754321860
oncall-sre: can we shift prod traffic away from auth-proxy to fallback route? suggest temporary weight swap
ben: I'm preparing LB patch to move 80% -> fallback for /generate
chandra: also seeing rate limiter tripping; may be tight threshold causing cascading failures
alice: command to view auth-proxy pod logs: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/auth-proxy --since=5m`
ben: applying LB weight change now (patching ingress) — patch posted in ops channel
alice: raising rate limiter soft limit to reduce rejections: `rlimitctl set inference 1500` (temporary)
ben: starting rollback of auth-proxy to v2.4.0 (rolling restart) — kicking off now
chandra: monitoring metrics: 503 count peaked at 14m, now dropping after LB shift
alice: auth-proxy pods back to v2.4.0 3/3, health checks passing
oncall-sre: PDR note: acknowledged by alice; please keep updates every 2m
ben: after rollback + LB shift + rlimit bump, 5xx down to 0.9% over 2m
chandra: sample request trace: `trace_id=xyz latency=120ms code=200` — success path returning
sre-manager: flagging for post-incident follow-up: investigate canary gating and rate-limit default
alice: adding temporary suppression for noisy threshold for 10m to avoid duplicate pages
pagerbot: PagerDuty PDR-789 status: mitigated (manual clear requested)
alice: monitoring for 10 more minutes, if stable will resolve and open follow-up ticket
ben: follow-up TODOs: enforce canary traffic policy, add metric alert for auth-proxy 503 ratio, revert rlimit tweak if not needed
chandra: opened ticket INF-1023 for postmortem and action items
alice: final check — last 5m 5xx = 0.4%, latency normal, customers not reporting errors
sre-manager: thanks team — please put timeline + notes in the ticket and CC customer-success for SLA assessment
alice: will do. closing oncall handoff in 5. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: PagerDuty PDR-789 resolved by alice — incident mitigated
alice: incident thread closed, will publish postmortem later
